comments.text: Another second here. There's a YouTube channel with full stoner metal albums (Stoned Meadow of Doom: [LINK] ; been around for quite a while, though I have a vague fear of them disappearing due to the obvious copyright infringement...). As for specific bands (though I don't think on the stoner metal spectrum, but ones I love): Baroness, Sub Rosa, King Woman, Bell Witch, Mastodon. And for something a bit farther off from metal, but still in the spirit of heavy, nearly ambient - The Kilimanjaro Darkjazz Ensemble ( [VIDEO] ) / The Mount Fuji Doomjazz Corporation (which is apparently the live version of "The Kilimanjaro...").

comments.text: I'm glad you like it :). I think ambience and soundscapes should still have interesting musical elements. If it only works as background noise, then I get bored by it. I've also listened to Isis quite a lot, mostly "Oceanic", which is great. There is a pretty good remix album of "Oceanic" that opens with a remix by Fennesz. Let me just throw a few more out there: Antenne (two albums, just called #1 and #2): [LINK] Jóhann Jóhannsson - Englabörn: [LINK] The Kilimanjaro Darkjazz Ensemble - Here Be Dragons: [VIDEO] Kreng - Grimoire: [LINK] La Grande Bellezza - Original Sound Track (sans disco tracks): [LINK]
